desktopScale.purpose: The dense desktop product scale for packages/ui. narrative.overview: Rennet is an editorial system for a serious developer tool. Dense technical material becomes fewer evidence-bearing objects without hiding the code underneath. The brand mark remains identity; provenance, continuity, and information density explain decomposition.
keyCharacteristics: Flat editorial fields and quiet reading surfaces.
Dense information resolves into a deliberate reading order.
Functional color names review meaning rather than decorating the page.
Light and dark are complete authored compositions.
Marketing and desktop share roles without becoming identical skins.

rules.name: The Sparse Color Rule
rules.body: Monochrome carries the identity; color appears only for review state, provenance, or structure.

rules.name: The Identity Is Not Layout Rule
rules.body: Never force the logo into a mask, connector, crop, or decomposition effect.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: A surface earns elevation by behaving like a separate review object.

dos: Do preserve the complete narrative and review sequence at every breakpoint.
Do show real product evidence or label illustrative material.
Do use committed black and white brand exports.
Do keep code visible while changing its reading order.
donts: Don't use the standalone mark as a decomposition device.
Don't turn the page into an equal-card feature grid.
Don't use gradients, glass, neon, or monospace as generic developer-tool identity.
Don't average independent model reviews into a synthetic consensus.
